purpose: SOL DORADO realtime 3D vehicle feasibility spike

source.notes: Four wheel nodes plus one body node. Runtime spike does not require skeletal animation.

runtime.derivation: Flattened node transforms, sampled the source 1K atlas into vertex colors, then applied an aggressive street-scale spatial clustering LOD. This tiny derivative is for visibility/performance testing, not final showroom quality.

integration.fallback: existing Veloce Sprint 2D artwork when WebGL, Three.js CDN, or GLB loading fails

provenance.note: Investigation asset. Confirm the Meshy account plan and any reference-input rights before treating this model as production-cleared.
